title: Tutti: one shared workspace for Claude Code and Codex, no more copy-pasting between agents

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: When you run clawed code and codecs on the same project, you become the messenger, pasting one's output into the other and reexplaining context every handoff. 2D gives them one shared workspace instead. It keeps conversations, files, app outputs, tasks, approvals, and running state connected so agents can reference each other's work, and you can steer the whole build from one control center.
